title: Sustainability | Google Cloud
description: Google Cloud reduces the environmental impact of cloud computing through innovative renewable energy purchasing and commitment.

sections.heading: Increase business resilience and sustainability with AI
paragraphs: Google Cloud offers organizations a new way to drive impact. We help businesses improve measurement, increase resilience, use energy and resources more efficiently and unlock new growth opportunities. With smarter use of data and AI you can have a more sustainable impact.

sections.heading: Measure
paragraphs: Organizations can use AI-powered insights to monitor their progress towards sustainability targets, in order to build business resilience.

sections.heading: Optimize
paragraphs: Organizations can work more efficiently by using AI to streamline energy and resource usage across their operations and supply chains.

sections.heading: Grow
paragraphs: Organizations can use AI to find new opportunities and markets in the low-carbon transition, with business models that unlock new forms of value.

paragraphs: With Earth Engine and Google Cloud organizations can leverage planetary observation data with large-scale compute, helping them measure and analyze environmental change and enabling leaders to make informed decisions.
